Subject: Coordinating Kerry Patel's virtual full-loop — slot folds & debrief owners

Hi all,

We have Kerry Patel (applied for Senior Backend Engineer) scheduled for a virtual full-loop next Friday, 12/19. Kerry is flexible but has asked to avoid late evenings. To keep the day predictable I'm proposing three "slot folds" (rolling windows) so we can offer the candidate a contiguous day while giving interviewers some breathing room:

- Fold A (morning): 09:00 — 12:00 PT (4 x 40-min interviews + 20-min debrief)
- Fold B (early afternoon): 13:00 — 16:00 PT (4 x 40-min interviews + 20-min debrief)
- Fold C (late afternoon): 16:30 — 19:30 PT (4 x 40-min interviews + 20-min debrief)

Sequence I'm proposing (candidate experience first):
1) System design (Karthik)
2) Core backend / architecture (Logan)
3) Product-context / cross-team (Marissa)
4) Hiring manager (Evan)

Can each of you confirm preferred fold(s) and volunteer to own the debrief for your interview? Debrief owners will be responsible for capturing the 1-paragraph take in the shared Debrief_Checklist.docx and being present for the 20-min synchronous debrief right after the loop.

I've attached Kerry's resume and a draft Panel_Roster.ics that I'll finalize once slots are locked. If anyone needs shorter 30-min deep dives instead of 40, say so — we can compress but I want to avoid splitting the candidate across widely separated times.

Thanks — aim to lock by EOD Monday so we can send the candidate an invite ASAP.

Best,
Tessa
Talent Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Kerry_Patel_Resume.pdf, Panel_Roster_v2.ics
